import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import string
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb

# Suppress output to ensure clean terminal state
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", None)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", None)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Preprocessing function
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t").replace("\\r", "\r")
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return text


# Extract metadata features for a comment - FIXED VERSION
def extract_metadata_features(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        text = ""

    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t").replace("\\r", "\r")
    text_len = len(text)

    features = np.zeros(16)

    # Original 13 metadata features (indices 0-12)
    features[0] = len(text)
    features[1] = sum(c.isupper() for c in text) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
    features[2] = text.count("!")
    features[3] = text.count(".")
    features[4] = len(
        re.findall(
            r"http[s]?://(?:[a-zA-Z]|[0-9]|[$-_@.&+]|[!*\\(\\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]))+",
            text,
        )
    )
    features[5] = text.count("#")
    features[6] = text.count("\n")
    special_count = sum(
        1 for c in text if c not in string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " "
    )
    features[7] = special_count
    features[8] = len(text.split())
    features[9] = text.count("?")
    features[10] = text.count(":")
    features[11] = text.count(";")
    punctuation_count = text.count("!?") + text.count(":") + text.count(";")
    features[12] = punctuation_count / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0

    # NEW 3 aggressive intensity features (indices 13-15)
    # 13: Multiple consecutive exclamation marks (2+ in a row)
    exclam_matches = re.findall(r"!{2,}", text)
    features[13] = len(exclam_matches)

    # 14: Multiple consecutive question marks (2+ in a row)
    question_matches = re.findall(r"\?{2,}", text)
    features[14] = len(question_matches)

    # 15: Ratio of words with 2+ consecutive uppercase letters (shouting emphasis)
    # Simplified approach: count words where all characters are uppercase with length >= 2
    words = text.split()
    shout_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) >= 2)
    features[15] = shout_words / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0

    return features


# Preprocess text for all data
X_train_raw = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
X_test_raw = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Fit word vectorizer on train only (to avoid data leakage)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=1, max_df=0.95
)
X_train_word, X_test_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(
    X_train_raw
), word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_raw)

# Fit char vectorizer on train only (to avoid data leakage)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    max_features=10000,
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_char, X_test_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(
    X_train_raw
), char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_raw)

# Combine TF-IDF features
X_train_tfidf = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_test_tfidf = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Split data BEFORE feature extraction to avoid data leakage
X_train_tfidf, X_val_tfidf, train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    X_train_tfidf,
    train_df["Insult"].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"].values,
)

# Extract metadata features AFTER the split to avoid data leakage
metadata_train = np.array(
    [extract_metadata_features(train_df["Comment"].iloc[i]) for i in train_indices]
)
metadata_val = np.array(
    [extract_metadata_features(train_df["Comment"].iloc[i]) for i in val_indices]
)
metadata_test = np.array(
    [extract_metadata_features(X_test_raw.iloc[i]) for i in range(len(X_test_raw))]
)

# Concatenate metadata with TF-IDF features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_tfidf, metadata_train])
X_val = np.hstack([X_val_tfidf, metadata_val])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_tfidf, metadata_test])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].iloc[train_indices].values
y_val = train_df["Insult"].iloc[val_indices].values

# Model with proven hyperparameters
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_child_weight=3,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="auc",
    verbosity=0,
)
model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_train, y_train), (X_val, y_val)], verbose=False
)

# Validation - proper hold-out estimate
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc}")

# Test Prediction
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
y_test_pred = np.clip(y_test_pred, 0, 1)

# Create submission - must match sample submission format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Date": test_df["Date"], "Insult": y_test_pred}
)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Prediction range: [{y_test_pred.min():.4f}, {y_test_pred.max():.4f}]")
